# Kharido Mart

> Kharido Mart is India's dedicated e-commerce brand for pediatrician-approved baby care essentials, screen-free Montessori educational toys, and postpartum mom wellness.

## About Kharido Mart
Kharido Mart (kharidomart.com) offers safe, certified, and sensory-friendly products designed specifically for babies, toddlers, and new mothers across India. Founded on the principle of tear-free, gentle care, all products adhere to non-toxic, BPA-free, and lead-free safety standards.

- **Website**: https://kharidomart.com
- **HQ**: New Delhi, India
- **Customer Care**: kharidomartsupport@gmail.com
- **Helpline / WhatsApp**: +91 85400 17572 (Mon-Sat, 10 AM - 6 PM IST)
- **Payment Options**: Cash on Delivery (COD) Pan-India, UPI (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm), Credit & Debit Cards, Net Banking
- **Shipping**: Free shipping on orders above ₹499. Dispatched within 24 hours, delivery in 2-5 business days.

## Core Categories

### 1. Gentle Baby Care & Grooming
- **Electric Baby Nail Trimmer**: Whisper-quiet 35dB motor, soft LED night light, and 6 age-graded cushioned grinding pads ensuring zero pinching of tiny cuticles.
- **Teething Essentials**: 100% food-grade silicone teethers, soft bristles, and soothing textured grips.
- **Nursery Care**: Infrared digital thermometers, gentle nasal aspirators, and bath temperature gauges.

### 2. Screen-Free Montessori Play
- **Interactive Audio & Sound Books**: Multilingual sound-press learning books featuring phonics, animal sounds, nursery rhymes, and vocabulary without blue light screens.
- **Sensory & Busy Boards**: Fine-motor skill development boards with latches, zippers, buckles, and tactile textures.
- **Cognitive Puzzles**: Non-toxic wooden stacking toys, shape sorters, and problem-solving activity sets.

### 3. Nursery Ambiance & Comfort
- **Touch-Activated Night Lights**: Soft squishy silicone animal lamps with warm, soothing glow and rechargeable USB battery.
- **Sleep Soothers**: White noise machines and lullaby sound companions for deep infant sleep.

### 4. Mom & Postpartum Wellness
- **Feeding & Nursing Pillows**: Ergonomic memory foam support pillows.
- **Hospital Bag & Maternity Essentials**: Organic nursing pads, diaper caddies, and postpartum recovery packs.
